Yes, pausing for confirmation feels right. When I clicked "Delete," it didn't just wipe the bookmark out — it asked "Delete this bookmark?" first, with a clear choice to cancel or go ahead. Since deleting is permanent, that little pause is exactly the kind of safety net I'd want so I don't lose something by an accidental click.

Variation A works well for me for delete.
